newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm with futures, offers thin.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm with futures, offers thin.

text.p: NWE naphtha was firmer on Monday alongside stronger futures, but offers remained thin.
Players assessed October swaps at around $207 cif NWE.
Small Russian pieces were heard available. One dealer said he had received an offer from a trader of a 5,000 tonne full-range piece at cif high +$1, cif Rotterdam.
But another player said this particular piece was not even worth as much as cif mean.
Apart from small Russian pieces, other offers were heard to be scarce, and few players said they had been in the market.
